scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:api"
scripts.dev:full: concurrently -n web,api,worker -c cyan,magenta,yellow "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:worker"
